question: What does SFN stand for?
correct_answer: System Frame Number

question: What is the main role of the UTM (UAS Traffic Management) in the 3GPP network?
options: To manage UAS node authentication and credential information
To establish C2 communications between the UAV and the ground control station
To extend the coverage and capacity of the cellular network
To support local routing and proximity-based services
To minimize RF interference in the network
correct_answer: To manage UAS node authentication and credential information

question: What is the International Mobile Station Equipment Identity (IMEI)?
options: A unique number allocated to each individual mobile station equipment in the PLMN
A dialable number allocated to a 3GPP System user
An application residing on the UICC for accessing IP Multimedia Services
An IMS security data and functions for IMS access by a terminal
An identifier for an Interconnecting unit in the 3G Core Network
correct_answer: A unique number allocated to each individual mobile station equipment in the PLMN

question: What is the main function of a Radio Network Controller (RNC)? [3GPP Release 17]
options: Control of one or more Node B
Communicating with Mobile Stations in a certain area
Serve one or more UTRAN cells
Provide the E-UTRA user plane and control plane protocol terminations towards the UE
correct_answer: Control of one or more Node B

question: In online charging without reservation, what happens if the OCS rejects the resource usage request? [3GPP Release 18]
options: The NE disallows the resource usage.
The OCS initiates a refund for the original resource usage.
The NE returns the resource usage authorisation to the network element.
The network element executes the resource usage according to the user request and the OCS authorisation.
correct_answer: The NE disallows the resource usage.

question: Which procedures are impacted by MUSIM according to TS 23.502 and TS 23.401? [3GPP Release 17]
correct_answer: All of the above

question: What is the definition of User in the context of 3GPP System?
options: A physically secure device used for accessing services provided by mobile networks
A radio interface between UTRAN and the User Equipment
An entity, not part of the 3GPP System, which uses 3GPP System services
A unidirectional radio link for the transmission of signals from a UE to a base station
A set of actions taken by the network to monitor and control the offered traffic
correct_answer: An entity, not part of the 3GPP System, which uses 3GPP System services

question: What is the purpose of paging in mobile networks?
options: To track service and resource usage levels
To transmit data as discrete units
To provide feedback on network reliability
correct_answer: To seek a User Equipment

question: What control mechanism allows/prevents UEs from accessing the network based on their capabilities? [3GPP Release 18]
options: Application Specific Congestion Control for Data Communication
correct_answer: Control of UE Capabilities

question: What are the common aspects of coexistence between SBA NFV-MANO systems? [ETSI NFV Release 5]
options: Usage of SBA specific common services
correct_answer: All of the above

question: What is the purpose of the work item on Enhanced LAA for LTE? [3GPP Release 14]
options: To enable operation of an LAA SCell on the UL in unlicensed spectrum
To support more than 1.04 million eNBs in a PLMN
To define the requirements and signaling support for a new UE category with a single receiver
To improve mobility and throughput performance under high speed scenarios
correct_answer: To enable operation of an LAA SCell on the UL in unlicensed spectrum

question: What is the basis for full duplex Ethernet? [IEEE 802.3]
correct_answer: MAU

question: What does the RAW slot assignment procedure define? [IEEE 802.11]
options: The number of RAW slots in a RAW
The procedure for accessing the medium within a RAW
The mapping function for determining the RAW slot index
The position index of the AID of a STA
correct_answer: The procedure for accessing the medium within a RAW

question: What is power saving mode?
options: A mode of operation similar to power-off, allowing a UE to greatly reduce its power consumption while remaining registered with the network.
A process that identifies that a ProSe-enabled UE is in proximity of another.
The ability to track service and resource usage levels and provide feedback on the responsiveness and reliability of the network.
An information unit identified by a label at layer 3 of the reference model.
A telecommunications network providing mobile cellular services.
correct_answer: A mode of operation similar to power-off, allowing a UE to greatly reduce its power consumption while remaining registered with the network.

question: What is the definition of Pilot Identity?
options: The process that identifies that a ProSe-enabled UE is in proximity of another
A data stream that is transmitted on one physical channel in each cell of the active set
The maximum bit rate offered to the user for a given time period
A service specific public address used for initial contact
The difference between the maximum and the minimum total transmit output power
correct_answer: A service specific public address used for initial contact

question: What actions can a UE take based on the recommended bitrate from the eNB? [3GPP Release 14]
options: Initiate an end-to-end rate adaptation with the peer UE
correct_answer: Initiate an end-to-end rate adaptation with the peer UE

question: What type of field does the Public Identifier URI/FQDN field contain? [IEEE 802.11]
correct_answer: URI

question: What is the purpose of Discontinuous Reception (DRX) in idle mode? [3GPP Release 17]
correct_answer: To reduce power consumption

question: What parameters are specified for MBS broadcast MTCH configurations? [3GPP Release 17]
options: Parameters that are specified for MBS broadcast MTCH
correct_answer: Parameters that are specified for MBS broadcast MTCH

question: Which technology can be used for the connection between the Evolved ProSe Remote UE and the Evolved ProSe UE-to-Network Relay? [3GPP Release 17]
correct_answer: Both E-UTRA and WLAN

question: What does the Channel Number field indicate? [IEEE 802.11]
options: The channel set of the AP indicated by this BSSID
The last known primary channel of the AP indicated by this BSSID
The PHY type of the AP indicated by this BSSID
The subelement format and ordering of subelements
correct_answer: The last known primary channel of the AP indicated by this BSSID

question: When can a UE transmit new data in LTE if there is new data arrival? [3GPP Release 18]
options: Immediately in the same TTI (Transmission Time Interval)
In the next first (s)TTI of the transmission window
After waiting for a random time period
After waiting for a predefined number of TTIs
correct_answer: In the next first (s)TTI of the transmission window

question: What are some of the key performance indicators used to characterize the quality of positioning information for vehicle-to-everything scenarios?
options: Positioning accuracy, latency, update rate, and reliability.
correct_answer: Positioning accuracy, latency, update rate, and reliability.

question: What is the time constant for a person standing on a ground plane with a resistance of 1000 MΩ and a capacitance of 150 pF? [IEEE C95.1]
correct_answer: 150 ms
